item.name: Join group rejects missing invite code

exec: // A member must provide an invite code before joining.
pm.test('missing invite code is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('response explains the missing code', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invite code is required'));

request.description: Try to join with the authenticated member but no invite code. Expect HTTP 400 before the valid join request.

exec: // This request inherits the member token set by the preceding login.
// Confirm the saved invite code joins the intended group.
pm.test('join response identifies the target group', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().group.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('groupId')));

request.description: Use the member token inherited from the collection and the saved invite code to join the owner's group. Expect HTTP 200 and a group ID matching the created group.

exec: // Reusing the invite must not create another membership.

request.description: Join the same group again with the member token and saved invite code. Expect HTTP 409 because the membership already exists.

exec: // Confirm current members may query quizzes and the new group starts empty.
pm.test('member can list quizzes in joined group', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('new group initially has no quizzes', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().quizzes).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty);

request.description: Use the saved member token to list quizzes in the joined group before any quiz is created. Expect HTTP 200 and an empty quizzes array.
